clips.title: The story
paras: Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, where ravenous lupine predators of the Nightbane pack have overrun the abandoned grove. Once it supplied fruit to nearby Darkshire, but now its trees and buildings lie in ruin.

In the Rotting Orchard, Nightbane worgen have made camps among the ruined barns and outbuildings. The orchard lies east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Withered fruit hangs from its trees, and Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush. Nightbane Shadow Weavers practice their dark magic among the decaying timber. The fierce worgen Gutspill and Nefaru lead the pack from their lair in the nearby mine of Roland's Doom.
